filter_rules.row_filter: ER > 0 AND TI > 0 (non-null); both files concatenated
filter_rules.stratum_with_n_ge_5: every (Process, Methodology) after row filter with n >= 5
filter_rules.ols: OLS logER ~ logTI (ordinary least squares, classical and HC3 SE)
filter_rules.theil_sen: scipy.stats.theilslopes(logER, logTI), method='hip' (median of pairwise slopes)
filter_rules.bootstrap_rows: 2000 resamples of rows with replacement, percentile 95% CI on OLS slope
filter_rules.bootstrap_clusters: 2000 resamples of Reference clusters with replacement, percentile 95% CI
filter_rules.leave_one_compilation_out: drop each Compilation level in turn, refit OLS slope
filter_rules.threshold_sensitivity: two large nonglacial strata only: ER 1%/5% two-sided trim; TI >= 1 yr; TI >= 10 yr; Area >= p10 (on non-null Area subset)
filter_rules.outlier_treatment: all rows; winsorized logER at 1/99 and 5/95; winsorized raw ER at 1/99 and 5/95; trimmed logER at 1%/5% two-sided
